items: However, existing TTA solutions face significant shortcomings when applied to autonomous driving.
Operating only on the ego vehicle's perspective makes it difficult to generate reliable labels for partially occluded objects or resolve perceptual ambiguities.
This limitation of these methods, due to data quality, inherently restricts their potential in pseudo-labeling.
